origin: Original paraphrased comparative questions informed by public film discussion themes and the user's stated research tasks; not copied answer keys.
source_policy: URLs are discovery context, not admitted evidence or gold. Confirm support against exact approved source revisions before scoring. Public theme recurrence has not been established for every question.
split_policy: Thirty development questions and twenty question-holdout cases on distinct pairs. Films overlap across splits; this is not film-disjoint or independently adjudicated. Do not tune after opening held-out model outputs.
